$schema: Single source of truth for FrontalOS brand colors. Parsed directly from brand_color_palette.md (NeuroSync / Synapsa, v1.0). Do not hand-edit hex values without updating brand_color_palette.md first.

meta.rule_60_30_10: 60% Deep Navy dominant / 30% Calming Teal support / 10% Soft Amber Coral highlight. See core.primary, core.secondary, core.accent respectively.
meta.no_neons_rule: No neon/fluorescent reds or bright yellows anywhere in the UI — they trigger stress/anxiety responses in ADHD patients. Never introduce colors outside this token set without updating brand_color_palette.md first.

secondary.name: Calming Teal
secondary.role: 30% Support — primary action CTAs, focus lines

primaryDark.name: Primary Dark
primaryDark.role: Main headings, dark cards (same value as neutral.textInk)

primaryMain.name: Primary Main
primaryMain.role: Sidebar and global navigation (same value as core.primary)

tealMain.name: Teal Main
tealMain.role: Primary action CTAs and focus states (same value as core.secondary)

tealLight.name: Teal Light / Subtle
tealLight.role: Success alert background, subtle shading on exercise cards

amberAccent.name: Amber Accent
amberAccent.role: Dopamine indicators, break warnings, medication notifications (same value as core.accent)

amberSoftTint.name: Amber Soft Tint
amberSoftTint.role: Gentle warning message background for parent portal

danger.name: Muted Terracotta
danger.role: Error/destructive text & borders on light surfaces. Deliberately desaturated (not fire-engine red) per the no-neons rule in section 5 — a saturated alert red would trigger the same stress response the palette is designed to avoid.

softBg.role: Error message background on light surfaces

onDark.role: Error text/border on dark navy chrome (Doctor/Patient/Admin portals), same desaturated hue lightened for contrast

onDarkBg.role: Error message background on dark navy chrome
